description: Prefill the Film Leader Countdown Maker: a classic film leader countdown with grain, scratches and flicker. Returns a link that opens the Tool with these options; the user presses Export there to download the video. All options are optional. Icons and images that need a file upload are not supported.

bg.description: Color of the film leader background. Default: "#d3d3d3".

flicker.description: Intensity of the film flicker effect. Default: "medium".

grain.description: Intensity of the film grain effect. Default: "medium".

hairs.description: Intensity of the film hairs effect. Default: "medium".

ink.description: Color of the numbers and rings. Default: "#1b1e1b".

interval.description: Seconds each number stays on screen. Default: 1.

jitter.description: Intensity of the film jitter effect. Default: "medium".

scratches.description: Intensity of the film scratches effect. Default: "medium".

sound.description: Sound played at each count; "off" for silence. Default: "clip1".

start.description: Number the countdown starts from, counting down to 1. Default: 10.

vig.description: Darkened vignette around the edges: 1 on, 0 off. Default: true.

vigalpha.description: How strong the vignette is. Default: 50.

vigsize.description: How far the vignette reaches in from the edges. Default: 100.

name: create_film_leader_countdown
title: Film Leader Countdown Maker
